storyCards.headline: Don't Leave Me This Way: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
The Communards's "Don't Leave Me This Way" reached #40 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #40 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 13 weeks on the chart.

Don't Leave Me This Way was released in 1986.

"Don't Leave Me This Way" by The Communards.

Chart story — peaked at #40 on the Hot 100.
